survival.etiquette_tipping_is_typically_5_10_br: Tipping is typically 5-10%. Bring cash for smaller cafes.
survival.etiquette_always_wait_for_the_pedestrian: Always wait for the pedestrian green light (Ampelmännchen) before crossing the street.
survival.etiquette_sunday_is_a_day_of_rest_ruhet: Sunday is a day of rest (Ruhetag); most shops and grocery stores will be completely closed.
survival.etiquette_always_make_direct_eye_contact: Always make direct eye contact when clinking glasses and saying 'Prost'.
survival.etiquette_service_is_included_service_c: Service is included (service compris), but leaving small change is appreciated.
survival.etiquette_always_distinctly_say_bonjour: Always distinctly say 'Bonjour' when entering a shop or greeting staff.
survival.etiquette_avoid_raising_your_voice_in_pu: Avoid raising your voice in public transit, cafes, and restaurants.
survival.etiquette_tipping_is_generally_not_pract: Tipping is generally not practiced and can actually be considered rude.
survival.etiquette_bowing_is_the_standard_greetin: Bowing is the standard greeting; physical handshakes are much less common.
survival.etiquette_always_remove_your_shoes_when: Always remove your shoes when entering homes, ryokans, and traditional spaces.
survival.etiquette_it_is_considered_highly_impoli: It is considered highly impolite to eat or drink while walking on the street.
survival.etiquette_a_service_charge_coperto_is: A service charge (coperto) is usually added automatically to restaurant bills.
survival.etiquette_greetings_often_involve_a_kiss: Greetings often involve a kiss on both cheeks among friends. Always start with the right.
survival.etiquette_avoid_ordering_a_cappuccino_af: Avoid ordering a cappuccino after 11 AM; it is strictly viewed as a breakfast drink.
survival.etiquette_dress_conservatively_when_visi: Dress conservatively when visiting churches—shoulders and knees must remain covered.
survival.etiquette_lunch_is_typically_very_late: Lunch is typically very late (2 PM - 4 PM), and dinner is often served after 9 PM.
survival.etiquette_tipping_5_10_is_customary_acr: Tipping 5-10% is customary across restaurants and cafes but not strictly enforced.
survival.etiquette_because_of_the_afternoon_siest: Because of the afternoon siesta (2 PM - 5 PM), expect many smaller shops to temporarily close.
survival.etiquette_always_greet_elders_with_high: Always greet elders with high respect, often accompanied by a slight bow or nod.
survival.etiquette_haggling_is_completely_expecte: Haggling is completely expected and encouraged in all open-air markets.
survival.etiquette_when_eating_local_traditional: When eating local traditional foods like 'swallow', always use only your right hand.
survival.etiquette_never_use_your_left_hand_to_gi: Never use your left hand to give or receive items from another person.
survival.etiquette_queueing_standing_in_line_is: Queueing (standing in line) is an absolute cultural pillar. Never cut in line.
survival.etiquette_tipping_10_15_in_restaurants: Tipping 10-15% in restaurants is highly standard unless 'service included' is stated.
survival.etiquette_when_using_escalators_especia: When using escalators (especially on the London Tube), always stand on the right and walk on the left.
survival.etiquette_a_standard_10_service_charge: A standard 10% service charge is almost always pre-included on your bill.
survival.etiquette_brazilians_are_very_warm_and_o: Brazilians are very warm and often greet with a hug or a cheek kiss.
survival.etiquette_always_use_a_napkin_to_hold_fi: Always use a napkin to hold finger foods like sandwiches or pizza—do not eat with bare hands.
survival.no_guide_intro: We don't have detailed local tips for {{country}} yet — here are a few universal reminders:
survival.generic_tip_1: Keep copies of your passport and important documents, physical and digital.
survival.generic_tip_2: Look up the local emergency number before heading out.
survival.generic_tip_3: Observe local dress codes and customs, especially at religious or cultural sites.
